delivery.affected_flow: methodology onboarding and external skill supply-chain governance

product_contract.outcome: A target project can detect its technology profile, preflight methodology copying, quarantine external skill candidates, govern activation, and maintain a bounded knowledge index.
acceptance_steps: Preflight produces a file-level add/same/conflict plan without modifying the target.
Candidates without provenance or license evidence are quarantined and cannot become callable.
Methodology audit rejects a package that lacks onboarding assets.
non_goals: Do not import an external GitHub skill in this delivery.
Do not overwrite existing project-owned rules, scripts, skills, or runtime data.
Do not treat a knowledge index as runtime or business truth.

truth_owner: rules/AGENTS.md, skills/SKILL_MANIFEST.json, and the project-owned onboarding CLI/audit gates.

write_allowlist: docs/每日调研回写/2026-09-21_项目接入与技能供应链治理.md
out_of_scope: Existing unrelated methodology, internationalization, MCP, adapter, and generated-output changes in the working tree.
Runtime application behavior and production data.
scope.rollback_or_recovery: Revert only the exact METH-ONBOARDING-01 commit; no project-owned existing asset was deleted or overwritten.

test_strategy.public_seam: project_onboarding.py inspect/preflight/govern-candidates commands and the methodology structural audit.
test_strategy.rationale: This governance feature is exercised through deterministic CLI outputs and focused regression fixtures rather than a domain runtime write.

final_proofs.claim: Technology detection, non-mutating preflight, candidate quarantine, and license enforcement behave as required.
The formal methodology package and scenario fixtures enforce the onboarding assets.
final_proofs.command_or_check: py scripts/py/audit_methodology.py --project-root .; py scripts/py/audit_skill_health.py --project-root .; py scripts/py/test_methodology_scenarios.py --project-root .

final_proofs.claim: The live preflight lists only source assets and excludes generated cache paths.

evidence_records.reference: Fresh final regression run required after this contract update.
Fresh final methodology gate run required after this contract update.
Fresh final preflight run required after this contract update.

standards_truth.evidence: Scoped diff review, exact write allowlist, methodology audit, skill-health audit, and frontmatter/path gates passed.

product_spec.evidence: The implementation covers the five requested onboarding outcomes: detection, integration, safe copy, post-copy governance, and knowledge indexing.
